discussion_comments.comment_body: DISMISS — Accept header is a hardcoded literal with negligible regression risk; asserting on it would over-couple tests to implementation details.
Fixed in 0071f1cf — `createSkillCollisionFixture` now returns `{root, bmadDir}` so the test cleans up `fixtureRoot` (the mkdtemp parent) instead of just the `_bmad` child.
Good catch — replaced `Date.now()` with `fs.mkdtemp()` to match all other test suites.

Won't fix — the two existing assertions (markers absent + user content present) provide adequate coverage for a simple string-splice operation. An exact-match assertion would add brittleness with negligible gain.
